name: Subtalar Dislocation
definition: Simultaneous dislocation of talocalcaneal and talonavicular joints without talar-neck fracture, usually after high-energy inversion or eversion trauma.

investigations.principle: Radiographs and CT after reduction assess associated fractures.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, infection, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

amber: Irreducible or open injuries may require operative reduction.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Pada/Gulpha Sandhi displacement may be documented after modern reduction.

patientEducation.summary: Simultaneous dislocation of talocalcaneal and talonavicular joints without talar-neck fracture, usually after high-energy inversion or eversion trauma.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, major trauma, rapidly progressive weakness, suspected serious infection, sepsis, pathological instability or other listed red flags.
